company.shortDescription: Globe provides a real estate platform that allows people to live more comfortably.
company.description:
Globe provides a real estate platform that allows people to live more comfortably. The company's platform offers short stays instead in people's homes or noisy coffee shops when people need privacy in between meetings or after a flight, without any advance booking.

Globe was founded on 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco,  California.
